test_is_monotonic_numeric: test Series.is_monotonic_increasing on a numeric Series and verify it returns True for sorted data
test_is_monotonic_decreasing_numeric: test Series.is_monotonic_decreasing on a descending numeric Series and verify it returns True
test_is_monotonic_dt64_increasing: test Series.is_monotonic_increasing on a datetime Series and verify it returns True for sorted dates
test_is_monotonic_dt64_decreasing: test Series.is_monotonic_decreasing on a reversed datetime Series and verify it returns True
test_is_monotonic_non_monotonic: test Series.is_monotonic_increasing on random numeric data and verify it returns False
